source: Built-in example; CORR, CR2, rho 0.8; intervention and dose_weeks predictors.
plain: The analysis included 13 dependent effects in 5 clusters. A meta-regression accounted for dependence within each cluster. The intercept describes the estimated effect when every predictor is zero; it is not an overall pooled effect. The estimates describe associations and do not establish causation or clinical importance.
methods: Effects and sampling variances on the supplied analysis scale were analysed using the Hedges–Tipton–Johnson correlated-effects (CORR) working model, with correlation ρ = 0.80. An intercept was added automatically. The between-cluster variance used the CORR moment estimator truncated at zero. Each effect was weighted by the reciprocal of the product of its cluster size and the sum of that cluster’s mean sampling variance and τ². Inference used the CR2 bias-reduced sandwich correction and coefficient-specific Satterthwaite degrees of freedom. Two-sided t tests compared each coefficient with zero; 95% confidence limits were the estimate plus or minus the corresponding t quantile times its robust standard error. The app applied no effect transformation or back-transformation. It computed no prediction interval or I² statistic. Analyses were run in allmeta rve-meta <build.version> (commit <build.shortSha>).
results: There were 13 effects, 5 clusters and 3 coefficients. Between-cluster variance τ²(CORR) = 0.0000; working correlation ρ = 0.80. Coefficient 0: estimate 0.767, robust SE 0.222, t = 3.45, df = 1.50, 95% CI −0.570 to 2.104, p = 0.110. Coefficient 1: estimate −0.144, robust SE 0.155, t = −0.93, df = 1.15, 95% CI −1.602 to 1.313, p = 0.506. Coefficient 2: estimate −0.027, robust SE 0.010, t = −2.63, df = 1.52, 95% CI −0.087 to 0.033, p = 0.156. Coefficients follow the displayed table order, beginning with the intercept.
flags: Coefficient 0: no clear evidence of a difference (the confidence interval includes no effect). This does not establish absence of an association.
Coefficient 1: no clear evidence of a difference (the confidence interval includes no effect). This does not establish absence of an association.
Coefficient 2: no clear evidence of a difference (the confidence interval includes no effect). This does not establish absence of an association.
Low Satterthwaite degrees of freedom limit the precision of inference.
